rules.name: AI — Unauthorized Model Deployment

rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_004", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%unauthorized%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%model%') AND "value" > 0
